narration.text: Every subcontractor's insurance checked on the policy, not the certificate, before it mobilizes. This is a chore for the project administrator of a general contractor building a three-storey medical office building, with ten subcontractors mobilizing over six weeks. Athena works it across 4 portals: Sitegrid, Subhub, Coverwell and Mailnest. On the bench, she found 4 of 9 eligible items, worth 3,200 dollars of the 7,200 dollars there was to find. All 4 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 11 traps, and she walked past 11. Among them: A certificate that says 'ongoing and completed operations' on a policy with CG 20 10 only. A certificate that says 'additional insured per written contract' on a policy with no endorsement at all. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 52 times faster. The verdict: short. Found 44% of the value, expected 75%; found 4 of 9 items, expected 75%. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
